walkthrough.configureClaudeCode.descript: Point Claude Code at the same loopback proxy and list every OpenCode Go model in its /model picker.
config.title: OpenCode Go for Codex
config.codexHome.desc: Directory containing Codex's `config.toml`. Leave empty to use the `CODEX_HOME` environment variable, or `~/.codex`.
config.codexExecutable.desc: Path to the Codex executable used to build Codex's model catalog (`codex debug models`) and to check the config still loads. Leave empty to auto-detect the Codex CLI or the binary bundled with the Codex VS Code extension.
config.maxBackups.desc: Maximum number of timestamped `config.toml.bak-*` backups to keep.
config.showUsage.desc: Show OpenCode Go plan usage in the status bar item. The item stays visible so its hover actions remain available.
config.usageRefreshInterval.desc: How often (minutes) the OpenCode Go plan usage is refreshed, clamped to 1-60.
config.usageDisplayWindow.desc: Which quota window the usage status bar item shows in its text.
config.usageWarningThreshold.desc: Usage percentage at which the status bar item turns yellow. The worst of the three windows decides.
config.usageErrorThreshold.desc: Usage percentage at which the status bar item turns red. The worst of the three windows decides.
config.proxyPort.desc: Port for the loopback OpenCode Go proxy (1024-65535).
config.claudeCode.defaultModel.desc: OpenCode Go model Claude Code uses when a request names an unconfigured Claude model. Leave empty to forward unknown ids unchanged. Takes effect in the proxy immediately.
config.claudeCode.opusModel.desc: OpenCode Go model the `opus` tier and any unmapped Opus model id route to. Empty falls back to the default model.
config.claudeCode.sonnetModel.desc: OpenCode Go model the `sonnet` tier and any unmapped Sonnet model id route to. Empty falls back to the default model.
config.claudeCode.haikuModel.desc: OpenCode Go model the `haiku` tier, background tasks and any unmapped Haiku model id route to. Empty falls back to the default model.
config.claudeCode.fableModel.desc: OpenCode Go model the `fable` tier routes to. Empty falls back to the Opus model, then the default model.
config.claudeCode.subagentModel.desc: OpenCode Go model Claude Code subagents route to. Empty falls back to the default model.
config.claudeCode.settingsPath.desc: Path to Claude Code's `settings.json`, or to the directory containing it. Leave empty to use `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`, then `~/.claude`.
config.claudeCode.executable.desc: Claude Code CLI used to read the installed version, so the model list and `behavesAs` are only written where they are supported. Leave empty to auto-detect `claude` on PATH.
config.claudeCode.replaceBuiltInPicker.d: Write `replaceBuiltInOptions: true` so Claude Code's `/model` picker lists the OpenCode Go models instead of the built-in Claude lineup.
config.claudeCode.useBehavesAs.desc: Give each picker row a `behavesAs` Claude profile so Claude Code applies known capabilities and effort defaults. Off by default because it also changes how cost is displayed.
